 Archive of Our Own (AO3) Faces Month-Long Offline Window Following Security Breach
 Cyber 
 11/02/2026 
 Popular non-profit fan-fiction repository Archive of Our Own (AO3) was abruptly taken offline after administrators detected evidence of an underlying security incident. While initial estimates suggested a brief maintenance window, the Organization for Transformative Works (OTW) revised its projection, warning that full service restoration could take anywhere from two to four weeks. Administrators confirmed that core user data including fanfictions, bookmarks, and kudos has not been deleted and remains intact, though investigations into the full scope of the breach are ongoing. The OTW has not entirely ruled out the possibility that user account data may have been accessed, prompting widespread security warnings for users who reuse credentials. The unexpected shutdown triggered massive community reactions across alternative platforms like Tumblr and Bluesky, coinciding awkwardly with the final days of major October fan-writing events.
 Full report : The Organization for Transformative Works warns that investigating and remediating the platform’s security incident could take up to four weeks, leaving millions of users scrambling.
